paid_market_gaps.gap: SEC materiality and board-governance tooling is enterprise, quote-only (board portals, CRQ); nothing affordable for smaller registrants
Small DoD suppliers face up to ~$594k total CMMC cost; software is cheap but implementation and assessment dominate
No dedicated product found for Coast Guard MTS Cybersecurity Plans due July 2027; operators rely on Coast Guard guides
CCPA cybersecurity audits served by Big-4/audit firms; mapping SOC 2 evidence to the 18 CCPA components stays manual

wtp_evidence: Regulation-forced buyers pay published prices (FutureFeed $99-$399/mo, NIS2-Autopilot EUR 249-799/mo), but small firms resist; DoD suspended CMMC Phase II over cost.
bundling_note: Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager gives CMMC templates free in GCC/GCC High (premium elsewhere) and open-source CISO Assistant covers NIS2 free, but no cloud bundles disclosure governance.
summary: Crowded for CMMC/NIS2 checklists, and CMMC demand is paused; a narrower opening exists in affordable SEC materiality/board-approval evidence for smaller registrants and in underserved regimes (Coast Guard MTS plans, CCPA audits).
